30–60 min per day; minimum 25 days for the full outfit

The gnomes of {wiki:The Spike|The Spike} need help fighting the enemies around their base. Depending on your level you do 4 daily tasks in the Upper, Middle or Lower Spike; each gives experience and 1 fame point. With the fame you accumulate you buy the {wiki:Cave Explorer Outfits|Cave Explorer Outfits} and their addons.
North teleport next to Xelvar (Kazordoon temple)
You don't need {item:Teleport Crystal|Teleport Crystals} to get to The Spike.
Bought from {npc:Gnommander} with fame points from the tasks ({key:reward}, {key:worthy}): you need 100 fame for the full outfit.
They also cost 1,000 gp (outfit), 2,000 gp (1st addon) and 3,000 gp (2nd addon).

Use the {item:Ghost Detector} on all 3 floors: it tells you which direction to follow (it only says **northeast, northwest, southeast or southwest**). Follow the directions and, once you're in the right spot, use the detector again to complete it. The location may be different for each player.
Malevolent Presence: possible locations on floor 1
Approximate locations where the presence may be on floor 1:
Malevolent Presence: possible locations on floor 2
Malevolent Presence: possible locations on floor 3
In the caves, kill **7** {creature:Demon Skeleton|Demon Skeletons}.
Go back from the caves to the safe zone and hand each finished task in to {npc:Gnomilly} (just like in the Lower Spike, say {key:report} and the name of the mission).
1,000 experience and 1 fame point per task

Reward for each task: 2,000 experience and 1 fame point. All the monsters in this section deal earth damage and most are weak to fire. Mages are the best vocation; knights and paladins on their own struggle, because there are many monsters at once and some resist physical damage.
Talk to {npc:Gnombold} on floor 4 of the Spike and accept the four missions: {key:nests}, {key:fertilise}, Geomantic Charges and {key:kill}.
Mages: bring a {item:Terra Set} and use {wiki:Fire Damage|fire} attacks.

On this floor you'll find the nests, the mushrooms and the monoliths. On the original map, the nests are marked with a red exclamation mark, the mushrooms with an orange star and the monolith with a blue question mark.
Go to the **south** side of the inner Spike (safe zone) and walk between the crystal structures to be disguised as a {creature:Mutated Bat}.
Still disguised, enter the cave and use the nests. You have to destroy **8**. You can only use nests while disguised. A nest "repairs" itself after 1 to 2 minutes and can be used again.

Look for big mushrooms in the caves and use the fertiliser on them. You have to do it on **4 different mushrooms**: you can't fertilise the same one twice. It counts per player, so you and a friend can fertilise the same mushroom.

Find charged magnetic monoliths and use the {item:Lodestone} on them. First time: {item:Partially Charged Lodestone}. Second time: {item:Highly Charged Lodestone}. Third time: you get *"You have charged you body with geomantic energy and can report about it."* The monoliths recharge in 1 to 2 minutes.
When you use a monolith you may be **teleported to a random spot** in the cave.
Kill **7** {creature:Crystalcrusher|Crystalcrushers}. They are the most dangerous monsters in this section, so be careful.
Go back from the caves to the safe zone and hand each finished task in to {npc:Gnombold} (as in the Lower Spike, {key:report} and the name of the mission).
2,000 experience and 1 fame point per task
Reward for each task: 3,500 experience and 1 fame point. The tasks are done on floors 6, 7 and 8 of the Spike.
Talk to {npc:Gnomargery} on floor -7: {key:hi}, {key:mission}. Accept each mission with {key:yes}: {key:deliver}, {key:undercover}, {key:temperature} and {key:kill}.
You receive 4 {item:Gnomish Supplies}. Find 4 of the 5 outposts and hand a package to each {npc:Gnome Trooper}: when he asks whether you have anything to deliver, say {key:something}.

Find at least **3** of the 9 gnome agents disguised as monsters, with names like {npc:A Vulcongra} or "A Nightmare Scion". Say {key:hi} to each one to receive the report. Look for monsters that behave strangely and wink at you.

Look for the **9 lava pools** on the 3 floors of the Lower Spike and use the {item:Thermometer} next to them. If it isn't the right spot you get *"This is not the hot spot!"*. When you get it right you get *"Whew! That was that hot, it melted the thermometer! At least you've found the hot spot!"*
The hot spot is the same for all players, but it changes every day at {wiki:Server Save} and can be on any of the 3 floors.
Kill **7** {creature:Drillworm|Drillworms} in the caves. You can also do it in the {wiki:Drillworm Caves}, outside The Spike.
Go back from the caves to the safe zone, talk to {npc:Gnomargery}, say {key:report} and then the name of the task: {key:delivery}, {key:undercover}, {key:temperature} or {key:kill}.
3,500 experience and 1 fame point per task

With enough fame, talk to {npc:Gnommander}: {key:reward}, {key:worthy} and choose {key:basic}, {key:first} or {key:second}. You need 100 fame for the full outfit (minimum of 25 days, because of the 20-hour cooldown).
More details about the outfit at {wiki:Cave Explorer Outfits Quest}.
In the Upper Spike, {creature:Corym Skirmisher|Corym Skirmishers}, {creature:Corym Charlatan|Corym Charlatans} and {creature:Corym Vanguard|Corym Vanguards} may rarely appear.
